def: to be hot (boil, of liquids; or glow, of solids), i.e. (figuratively) be fervid (earnest)

occurrences.text: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John.
Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
